title: NumPy
line: Fast arrays for numbers. Slice, mask and broadcast with no loops.

project.title: A tiny image editor
project.brief: Build a 64 by 64 grayscale image as an array on your own. Crop the middle, brighten it, turn it black and white with a mask and print the mean of each row.
checks: The image has shape (64, 64) and the crop has shape (32, 32)
The black and white image holds only the values 0 and 255
The notebook has no for or while loop

lessons.title: Make your first arrays
lessons.goal: Teach NumPy arrays in Jupyter. Import numpy as np, build arrays with np.array, np.arange, np.zeros and np.linspace, and turn a list of seven Celsius temperatures into Fahrenheit in one line.
lessons.passes: The cell prints a NumPy array of seven Fahrenheit temperatures.

lessons.title: Shape, dtype and reshape
lessons.goal: Teach ndim, shape, dtype, reshape and astype in NumPy by turning the numbers 1 to 12 into a 3 by 4 grid of floats.
lessons.passes: The array has shape (3, 4) and dtype float64.

lessons.title: Indexing and slicing
lessons.goal: Teach NumPy indexing and slicing on 2D arrays by pulling one row, one column and the middle 2 by 2 block out of a 4 by 4 grid of the numbers 0 to 15.
lessons.passes: The middle block has shape (2, 2) and holds 5, 6, 9 and 10.

lessons.title: Boolean masks
lessons.goal: Teach NumPy boolean masks and np.where by picking the days above 30 degrees out of a month of temperatures and counting them.
lessons.passes: Every selected value is above 30 and the printed count matches the mask.

lessons.title: Math along an axis
lessons.goal: Teach sum, mean, max and argmax with the axis argument in NumPy by finding each student's average and each test's top score in a 5 by 3 table of scores.
lessons.passes: The student averages have shape (5,) and the top scores have shape (3,).

lessons.title: Broadcasting
lessons.goal: Teach NumPy broadcasting rules by subtracting each test's mean from the 5 by 3 table of scores and scaling each column by a different weight, with no loop.
lessons.passes: The centred table has shape (5, 3) and every column mean is close to 0.

lessons.title: Random numbers with a seed
lessons.goal: Teach NumPy random numbers with np.random.default_rng and a seed by simulating 1000 rolls of two dice and counting how often the sum is 7.
lessons.passes: Running the notebook twice prints the same count of sevens.

lessons.title: Replace a loop with array math
lessons.goal: Teach vectorising in NumPy by rewriting a Python for loop that finds the distance of 10000 points from the origin as one array expression, then timing both.
lessons.passes: np.allclose says both results match and the array version takes less time.

lessons.title: Dot product and matrices
lessons.goal: Teach the dot product and matrix multiplication in NumPy with np.dot and the @ operator by turning a square of four 2D points by 90 degrees with a 2 by 2 matrix.
lessons.passes: The four points turned by 90 degrees match the expected array.
